constituents.name: NCR Planning Board: NCR constituent areas

processing.simplification: Douglas–Peucker, 30 m tolerance; coordinates rounded to 5 decimals (~1 m)

knownLimitations: Charkhi Dadri (carved out of Bhiwani in 2016) is not a separate polygon in the source; it is covered by the Bhiwani polygon.
Alwar is the district as constituted when notified as part of NCR; districts carved out of it in 2023 are not separated.
District edges are simplified; points within a few hundred metres of an edge are reported as near a boundary.
